title: Parking License Term, Commitment and Notice Schedule
content:
Schedule to the Parking License Addendum. For each parking product it gives the minimum commitment in licensed months, the written notice a cancellation requires, the early cancellation fee expressed in months of the monthly fee, how the license term runs, and whether the license carries over on a move to another apartment home in the same community.

| Parking product | Minimum commitment (months) | Notice to cancel (calendar days) | Early cancellation fee (months of the monthly fee) | License term runs | Carries over on an in-community transfer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Surface Unreserved Permit | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | month to month | Yes |
| Surface Reserved Space | 0 | 30 | 0.00 | month to month | Yes |
| Covered Carport Space | 3 | 30 | 1.00 | month to month | Yes |
| Structured Garage Space | 3 | 30 | 1.00 | month to month | Yes |
| EV Charging Reserved Space | 6 | 30 | 1.00 | month to month | Yes |
| Private Detached Garage | 12 | 30 | 1.00 | with the lease (lease-coterminous) | Yes |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The two surface products carry no minimum commitment (0 months) and an early cancellation fee of 0.00 months.
2. The Surface Unreserved Permit requires 0 days of notice; every other product requires 30 calendar days.
3. The commitment grows with the product: 3 months for the Covered Carport Space and Structured Garage Space, 6 for the EV Charging Reserved Space and 12 for the Private Detached Garage.
4. The Private Detached Garage is the only product whose term runs with the lease rather than month to month.
